name: The Drowned Depths
dig_description: A flooded labyrinth below the tide line. Strange bioluminescence pulses from submerged vaults.
lore_blurb: The third stratum descends below the drowned cities — salt-crusted ruins where the tide never truly ebbs.
warden_intro: The water stills — a terrible pressure builds in the dark.
A voice, ancient and wet, speaks from every bubble:
"You tread the abyss as though it were a road."
The Abyssal Warden unfolds from the murk — a crown of coral and eyes that do not blink.
warden_outro: The coral crown shatters; the water lightens.
The way to the heart of the deep lies open.
boss_intro: The abyss falls silent — even the currents hold their breath.
A second pulse, deafening, shakes the stone around you.
A shape vast as a drowned cathedral rises from the dark.
boss_outro: The great heart ceases its pulse. The waters recede.
The Leviathan's Heart crumbles into sediment and brine.
Far above, a crack of light breaks through the deep.
